title: Emit forward-slash repo-relative paths from the decisions citation sweep (3 Windows-red tests)
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/decisions/render.rs path_relative (~304-313), join components with "/" instead of std::path::MAIN_SEPARATOR_STR — repo-relative doc paths are spelled with forward slashes everywhere in bee (messages, stored decisions events); on Windows the native join leaks backslashes into sweep hits and door details. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/decisions/verbs_read.rs touches_sweep_excluded (~418-428), normalize the input with .replace('\\', "/") and compare against forward-slash literals directly (drop the native() closure); update the doc comment above it that currently says "native separators". No other files.
goal: Windows CI: verbs::decisions::tests::touches_sweep_excluded_matches_generated_index_and_bound_own_history_only, verbs::drivers::tests::close_refuses_at_the_impact_door, verbs::drivers::tests::impact_door_refuses_when_an_outside_doc_cites_a_feature_stamped_decision go green (CI run 31946481526); Linux suite stays green.
notes: Third wave of issue #94. Tests assert docs/knowledge/areas/other/notes.md:1 with forward slashes; Windows emitted backslashes from path_relative. impact_sweep_in_generated_tree in drivers/close.rs already normalizes backslash-to-slash — same pattern.
